author: GamingBolt
description:
Yet, through exceptionally responsive controls, momentum-driven matches, and a playloop designed for short, meaningful sessions, NBA: The Run nails a strong arcade identity. Despite defensive inconsistencies, readability issues, and limited modes at launch. Play By Play has crafted a solid foundation which they’ll undoubtedly build upon.

Whilst this isn’t a basketball sim, NBA: The Run still feels authentically like basketball, and you don’t need to be a seasoned baller to know that capturing the spirit of the game matters more than recreating it.
title: NBA The Run Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The latest Crimson Desert update has dropped, and once again, there are expansions to managing pets and mounts that make getting them and keeping them around a whole lot better. But that’s not all that’s on offer with this one. 

From such much-needed additions for Damiane and Oongka, to fixes that are certainly going to make your time in Pywel more convenient, this update continues the good work that the developer has been doing ever since the game was released, and it seems that the studio has no intention of stopping in the near future.

There are quite a few fixes and improvements that we think are very welcome. So, what’s changed? We’re happy to lay it all out for you, so join us as we tell you all about it!
title: Crimson Desert's Newest Update Brings 10 Big Changes and Teases Future Story Plans

author: GamingBolt
description:
2026 has been quite a good year if you’re a gamer, with all of us being spoilt for choices on awesome games to play in its first half. Well, we’re happy to tell you that the rest of the year is looking equally good, although September and October might be a tad too crowded thanks to the release of GTA 6 in November. 

Nevertheless, the rest of the gaming world is soldiering on, bringing some truly intriguing ideas and games to the table in what’s shaping up to be a very busy second half. From remakes of beloved classics to entirely new games from some very big names, we’re taking a look at some of the biggest games coming this year. Join us as we take you through what they’re about, and when you get to play them.
title: 40 Big Games Still Coming Out In 2026
